meta.name: skill-builder
meta.description: Automatically detect source types and build AI skills using Skill Seekers. Use when the user wants to create skills from documentation, repos, PDFs, videos, or other knowledge sources.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档、代码库等来源自动构建AI技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从各种资料中创建AI技能
copy.tagline_en: Automatically build AI skills from docs, repos, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to create AI skills from various sources

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能自动识别你提供的链接或文件类型（如文档网站、GitHub 仓库、PDF、视频等），然后使用对应工具抓取内容，并帮你打包成 AI 技能。
howto.when: 当你提供文档网址、GitHub 仓库名、PDF 文件、视频链接或本地代码目录，并希望将其转化为 AI 技能时触发。

say.text: 把这份 PDF 说明书打包成技能，导出到 Weaviate。
say.note: Claude 会抓取 PDF 并执行导出。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically detect the type of link or file you provide (e.g., documentation site, GitHub repo, PDF, video) and use the appropriate tool to scrape the content and package it into an AI skill.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a documentation URL, GitHub repo name, PDF file, video link, or local code directory and want to convert it into an AI skill.

say_en.text: Create an AI skill from this documentation site: https://example.com/docs
say_en.note: Claude will detect the source type and start scraping.

say_en.text: Package this PDF manual into a skill and export it to Weaviate.
say_en.note: Claude will scrape the PDF and perform the export.
